intro.title: Design DataTable API
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a reusable DataTable component in Vue, which displays structured data like user lists or product catalogs in a clean, tabular format. You'll learn how to design a component API by using props to make the table dynamic and configurable, allowing it to accept different datasets and column definitions. The core concept involves passing data and configuration from a parent component to the DataTable via props, enabling separation of concerns and reusability. You'll work with Vue's single-file components, JavaScript arrays and objects for data, and basic HTML table elements to structure the UI. By the end, you'll have a functional DataTable that can render any dataset you provide through its props.
intro.usecase: DataTable APIs are fundamental to enterprise dashboards and admin panels where users need to manage and analyze large datasets. In e-commerce platforms, product inventory tables use DataTable APIs to enable sorting by price, filtering by category, and pagination through thousands of items. Customer relationship management (CRM) systems rely on these APIs to display contact lists with searchable columns, bulk actions, and real-time updates. Developers implement DataTable APIs whenever they need to present structured data with interactive controls for efficient data exploration and management.
